text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer camp starts today! Sakura Chiyono O and Mejiro Ardan tell Yaeno Muteki about their injuries and recovery in detail.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although they are able to train, it seems like it'll be a while before either can compete in a race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki swears to do them both proud at the Kikuka Sho.
